items.title: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) Lifts Annual Dividend To $7.60 Per Share
items.summary: Automatic Data Processing (NasdaqGS:ADP) announced a board-approved dividend increase alongside director elections at its recent annual meeting. The ADP board authorized a materially higher regular cash dividend, signaling a larger cash return commitment to shareholders. Shareholders also voted in new directors to the ADP board, reshaping oversight of management and long term priorities.
